title: Agent Claim
description: A structured claim emitted by an agent at a stage gate. Free-text summaries are never used for gating; only this structured claim is.

type.description: Claim type; must match a key in verifier/catalogue.yaml.

agent.description: Name of the agent that emitted the claim.

stage.description: DevSecOps stage the claim belongs to.

subject.description: The exact artifact this claim applies to. Evidence for a different SHA or digest is rejected.

statement.description: Human-readable statement. Informational only — never used for gating.

asserted.description: The structured numbers/facts the agent asserts. The verifier compares these against observed evidence; a mismatch beyond tolerance is a caught lie.
